variants.specifics: Brackenford: Brother Anselm's novice Pip chased the Urchins into the old barrow and has not come back.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Praise be! No novice in all Brackenford is braver than my Pip. But the boy went after the Urchins into the old barrow east of the ford. Not a sign of him since, and the pests bite all who come near.

Bring him home safe, and a reward awaits you here.

Take this potion along, in case things go badly below.

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: I have no more potions to spare just now. Good fortune down in that barrow. Those Urchins can be a nasty, biting bunch.

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: Filthy Urchins have taken over this barrow, chasing me into every corner. You must lead me out, stay close and fend off these wretched beasts.

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text: Bless you, my son. You did a holy deed, and this chapel won't forget it.

journal.text: Lead the lost novice from the barrow to safety.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Vurn: Marra's boy Tobb went after the Trolls with a toy pick and is held in the Troll den.

plea.speaker: Marra
plea.text:
My Tobb is a brave boy. He went after the Trolls with his toy pick.

Down in the Troll den a little lad like him won't last the night. But since you have an honest face, I'll give you 50 gold to fetch him. You'll do it?

reminder.speaker: Marra
reminder.text: The Troll den lies below the East Shaft, you can't miss it.

found.speaker: Tobb
found.text: You must have come from my Ma.

following.speaker: Tobb
following.text: Please hurry, take me home to Ma.

completion.speaker: Marra
completion.text:
Tobb is home safe! I shall bless your name every day!

Here, take this gold. You've earned it ten times over!

The Trolls nearly ate him, but he heard one of those big smelly Troll cooks talk of a back door into Grutt's den. If you search the lower tunnels maybe you can find it!

journal.text:
Search the Troll den and bring Tobb back to his mother.

(Hint: Listen for his voice.)

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Dorla's little brother Wick was dragged off by the drowned dead to the Sunken Crypt.

plea.speaker: Dorla
plea.text:
Eeeeyaaah! Stay back! Don't eat me!

Oh. A person?! My eyes are swollen from crying. But you're surely none of those rotten dead men who dragged off my brother Wick! He's only a little boy.

If you could bring him home, you'd mend my heart and I'd thank you all my days.

reminder.speaker: Dorla
reminder.text: The Sunken Crypt is a hole without hope and will even drain a bit of the boldest man's courage away.

found.speaker: Wick
found.text: Here is my last apple, you have it. Take me back to my sister once you're ready.

completion.speaker: Dorla
completion.text:
Hooray, brave Adventurer! A thousand thanks for bringing my little Wick home! With him back, our house can finally sleep without fear of that wicked witch and her dead!

Here, this robe and this potion will serve you well -- better than you know.

journal.text: Bring Dorla's brother home from the Sunken Crypt.

variants.specifics: Varnhold: Hulda, the castle cook, begs for her son Tib, carried off by the Trolls to their pen at Grey Quarry.

plea.speaker: Hulda
plea.text: Please, save my boy! If the Trolls at Grey Quarry don't beat him or eat him, the cold will finish him anyway. His friend came home alone last night and the tale he told is a grim and terrible warning of my son's fate.

reminder.speaker: Hulda
reminder.text: I've got his stew warming. You fetch the boy.

found.speaker: Tib
found.text: Oh, a friendly face! Over here!

following.speaker: Tib
following.text: My feet are frozen, but my courage holds -- lead me home!

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: Tib! Have you lost your wits, chasing after Trolls? Kind sir, I can't thank you enough for bringing him back! Take this gold for your trouble. And good luck up at the Gatehouse!

journal.text: Bring Tib home safe from the Troll pen at Grey Quarry.

variants.specifics: Skarra: Gorm the fisherman's daughter Nella was taken by the Undead into the flooded cellar under the old smokehouse.

plea.speaker: Gorm
plea.text: There is a flooded cellar under the old smokehouse where the Undead have taken my daughter Nella. Before the lake rose, the whole village kept its salted fish down there. It holds dark passages and a few rotten floors, and I fear she will never find her way out alone.

reminder.speaker: Gorm
reminder.text: It is time you went after her. The water down there rises higher every hour.

found.speaker: Nella
found.text: Heeeeeeelp! Don't let them drag me under! I want to go home!

following.speaker: Nella
following.text: Rotten old corpses! You won't get me again!

completion.speaker: Nella
completion.text: Hooray! I'm back home and dry with my papa again!

journal.text: Find the smokehouse cellar and rescue Nella.

variants.specifics: Zanthis: Oona's apprentice Nib is lost in the catacombs among the Skeletons; the player brings him home.

plea.speaker: Oona
plea.text:
Thank goodness you've come, young sir! Skeletons are loose in the catacombs.

You must find my apprentice Nib and bring him home.

reminder.speaker: Oona
reminder.text: How can you just stand there? I need my apprentice back!

following.speaker: Nib
following.text: I hate the dark. Do you?

completion.speaker: Oona
completion.text: He's safe! The Masters will be most thankful for your bravery!

variants.specifics: Fort Kessry: Tessaly begs the player to bring her husband Dobbin back out of the old silver mine.

plea.speaker: Tessaly
plea.text:
No doubt you've heard about my husband Dobbin. He went into the old silver mine and never returned.

Since you look brave, I'll pay you 60 gold to bring him home. Will you do it?

reminder.speaker: Tessaly
reminder.text: Have courage, a few bats are nothing to fear. Return once Dobbin's been found.

completion.speaker: Tessaly
completion.text: Wonderful! You've brought my Dobbin home safe, lad! I hope that old mine never swallows anyone again. Now if you'll excuse us, we have plenty of catching up to do. Take this gold, and keep clear of Gorrak's Ogres if you value your neck!

journal.text: Bring Dobbin home from the old silver mine.

variants.specifics: Ferrik: Gretta's apprentice Pell is held by the Imps in the Ash Caverns.

plea.speaker: Gretta
plea.text: Hey there. Name's Gretta. Could you save my apprentice Pell from the Imps in the Ash Caverns? If you do, I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Gretta
reminder.text: Those wretched Imps are getting far too bold lately.

found.speaker: Pell
found.text: Help me reach the old ore lift. From there we can ride up past the slag heaps and home to Gretta's forge.

following.speaker: Pell
following.text: I'm sorry, sir, but I'm not built for running. Please we must go slower.

completion.speaker: Gretta
completion.text:
You brought Pell back, eh? Well, I had feared the Imps would roast him, but he hasn't got a single scorch mark on him!

Take this purse -- 50 gold pieces! Thank you for keeping my apprentice safe!

journal.text: Lead Gretta's apprentice Pell out of the Ash Caverns.

variants.specifics: Vellin Cross: Fennick the woodcutter's son Pell is held in the Ogre pens of Hagg Hollow.

plea.speaker: Fennick
plea.text:
I can't go back out there, lad. Too many Ogres watching from the trees on the road to Hagg Hollow.

Take the old cart track north out of town.

Find my boy Pell. He'll be in their pens if he's still alive.

Take this potion. It will mend your wounds should the brutes catch you. Careful out there, lad.

reminder.speaker: Fennick
reminder.text: Have you found my Pell yet?

found.speaker: Pell
found.text: The lock! The lock! Smash open the lock!

following.speaker: Pell
following.text: My knees may be knocking, but you didn't get to eat me, ugly Ogres. There is someone here, bigger and braver than you, who is taking me home.

completion.speaker: Fennick
completion.text: You brought my Pell home! Take this gold as a token of my appreciation. Oh, and one more thing! Here's a spell book some wizard left behind at the Gold Goose. Be careful with it. The last fellow who tried it lost his eyebrows. Thanks again, lad!

journal.text: Fennick's son has been dragged off to Hagg Hollow, and every man in town is too scared to follow. Somebody has to bring him back...

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Hobb the swineherd's son Tam is locked by Ogres in the cellar of the burned farmhouse.

plea.speaker: Hobb
plea.text:
Good day to you. Hobb's my name, and I keep pigs on the edge of Tarrow. Last night the Ogres dragged my son Tam away from the sty. Those brutes have him shut in the cellar of the burned farmhouse, with a few of them standing watch.

Please, run to that farmhouse and bring my boy back to me. This key will open the cellar door.

reminder.speaker: Hobb
reminder.text: Hurry! You're wasting precious time. Off with you.

following.speaker: Tam
following.text: This cellar is the scariest place I've ever seen. Let's run for home!

completion.speaker: Hobb
completion.text: Bless you for bringing my boy home.

journal.text: Rescue Hobb's son from the cellar of the burned farmhouse.
